visual_description: The image displays an open cookbook titled "Fix-It and Forget-It Christmas Cookbook 600" by the New York Times Bestselling Author, resting on a festive fabric with Santa Claus patterns. The right-hand page features recipes including "Fruited Christmas Wreath," "The Christmas Cookie Book," and "Cornmeal Dried Fruit Cookies," each accompanied by ingredient lists and step-by-step instructions. A red ribbon bookmark is tucked into the book, and decorative holiday items such as pinecones, a gingerbread house photo, and a green knitted item are arranged around it. The bottom of the page shows the date "NOVEMBER/DECEMBER 2024 LOC.GOV/LCM" and page number "17."
